title: Enrollment Status Page timeout is outside the sensible range

maxMinutes.text: Above this, a stuck device looks like a working one

minMinutes.text: Below this, slow networks time out unnecessarily

report.title: {Items.Count} Enrollment Status Page {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile has', 'profiles have')} an unhelpful timeout

messages.businessImpact: Too short and provisioning fails on a slow connection; too long and a genuinely stuck device holds a new starter at a progress screen for hours.
remediation: Set the timeout between 30 and 120 minutes, judged against how long a full provisioning takes on the slowest site.
messages.cannotSee: The timeout is judged against a range rather than against how long this tenant's own provisioning actually takes, which is not something a read-only run can measure. A tenant that has timed its build and set the value deliberately will be reported here.
